meta.subtitle: ABC Learning Book for Toddlers, Ages 2 to 8
meta.tagline: Come discover every letter with Pip the fox.

back.headline: A letter adventure with Pip
back.blurb: From A to Z, Pip the fox climbs, plays, and discovers a new word on every page. Look at the giant letters, find Pip in the pictures, say each sound out loud, and share a fun fact together — perfect for bedtime, car rides, and first readers.
bullets: Look, say, and find Pip on every page
A celebration when you finish the alphabet
back.closing: Open the cover. Meet Pip. Start the adventure.

front.copyright_line: A picture-book alphabet for curious little readers.
front.how_intro: Read it together. Look, say, and find Pip. There is no wrong way.

how_steps.title: Look
how_steps.text: Look at the giant letter. Say its name.

how_steps.title: Say
how_steps.text: Say the sound, then say the word out loud.

how_steps.title: Find Pip
how_steps.text: Where is Pip hiding this time? What is Pip doing?

how_steps.title: Discover
how_steps.text: Look at the big picture. Talk about the fun fact together.

activities.review_intro: Look at each letter. Can you say its sound?
activities.review_prompt: Say the letter, then say the word. Pip is proud of you!

certificate.title: You learned the alphabet!
certificate.body: You finished the whole alphabet with Pip the fox. What a brave letter explorer you are!
certificate.closing: The End — for now. Tomorrow there are more words to find.
